points.description: States that a variable is a location in memory (a storage location / named memory space / container held in memory). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks (1.25) if it only says a 'container' or 'place' to hold data without any reference to memory/storage location.

points.description: States that it stores/holds a value (data) that can be used by the program. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks (1.25) if the value is implied but vague, e.g. 'used for data' without saying it stores or holds a value.
